full_prompt_en: A square illustrated fantasy portrait places an elderly white-bearded traveler with a tall staff before a glowing orange disc, while smaller figures and dark woodland fill the lower frame. The background is almost black at the edges, threaded with thin gray trunks and clusters of rusty red leaves. A large vermilion-orange circle sits behind the traveler's head and shoulders, its surface marked with faint curling symbols that are too indistinct to read. The man occupies the upper center and right in a close three-quarter view. Long silver-gray hair falls around a deeply lined face, and heavy brows frame a direct, wary gaze. His broad pale beard runs down across his chest, broken into many fine strands. Light-colored layered cloth wraps the shoulder and arm, with cool slate shadows describing broad folds. Both hands grip the dark vertical staff near the lower left of his body. Its pointed upper end rises beyond the top edge, strengthening the upright axis against the round disc. The lower part of the image becomes a misty collage of smaller scenes. At the center, a cloaked dark figure walks forward, its long fabric sweeping to the right. To either side, additional pale and gray figures appear amid foliage, stone-like shapes, and small scraps of warm color. These lower silhouettes are partly submerged in blue-gray haze, so they support the larger portrait without competing with the face. The lighting is symbolic and directional: the warm disc separates hair and shoulders from the dark trees, while pale light touches the face, beard, hands, and fabric. Fine drawn contours and softly layered paint-like textures give the foreground weight; the supporting scenes are more diffuse. The palette holds ivory and cool slate blue against deep black and a concentrated ember orange. The overall composition combines the commanding close figure and tiny journeying forms, using scale, circular framing, and color contrast to suggest an epic story without literal action in the main portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻插画肖像把一名持高杖、留白须的年长旅人置于发光的橙色圆盘前，下方画面还铺有较小人物与深色林地。背景边缘近乎漆黑，其间穿插细灰树干和锈红树叶。一个巨大的朱橙色圆盘位于旅人头肩后方，盘面带淡淡卷曲符号，却模糊到无法辨认。男子以上部中央和右侧的近景四分之三视角出现。长长的银灰头发垂在皱纹深刻的脸旁，浓重眉毛框住直接而警觉的目光。宽大的浅色胡须沿胸前垂下，分出许多细丝。浅色多层布料裹住肩与手臂，冷石板灰阴影描出宽阔褶皱。双手在身体左下侧握住深色竖杖。杖的尖顶伸出画面上缘，在圆盘前强化直立轴线。下半幅转成一组迷雾中的较小场景。中央，一个披深色斗篷的人物向前走，长长的布料向右扫过。两侧还有浅色和灰色人物，出现在草木、石块般形状与细小暖色碎片之间。这些下方剪影部分沉入蓝灰薄雾，因而支持大型肖像，而不与面孔争夺注意。光线带有象征性和方向性：暖色圆盘把头发与肩膀从深色树木中分离，浅光则落在脸、胡须、手和衣料上。细绘轮廓与柔和叠加的绘画肌理赋予前景重量，陪衬场景则更加弥散。象牙白和冷石板蓝与深黑及集中的余烬橙形成调色对比。整体构图结合具有统领感的近景人物与微小行旅形体，利用尺度、圆形框景和色彩对比暗示宏大故事，而主肖像没有进行明确动作。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy illustration layers finely drawn figure work over atmospheric collage and an emphatic circular color field. Ivory and cool slate tones model the main volumes through many small strokes, while a concentrated ember orange disc supplies the chief warm contrast. Dark foliage-like tracery and irregular peripheral marks create a dense frame around a clearer central focal area. The largest form has precise facial and textile detail; much smaller supporting shapes merge into blue-gray haze, establishing scale without a realistic single depth plane. A vertical line cuts through the broad circle and steadies the layered composition. Light separates pale contours from deep black surroundings, with soft directional highlights on raised folds and strands. Subtle grain and worn pigment keep even the brightest areas tactile. The overall effect is mythic and solemn, using nested scales, symbolic geometry, and restrained warm-cool contrast to give a still image narrative breadth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种奇幻插画把细绘形体叠在大气拼贴和醒目的圆形色域之上。象牙白与冷石板色通过许多小笔痕塑造主要体积，集中的余烬橙圆盘则提供主要暖色对比。深色枝叶般细线与不规则周边痕迹在较清楚的中央焦点周围形成密集框架。最大的形体拥有精确的面部和织物细节，远小得多的陪衬形状融入蓝灰薄雾，建立尺度却不依赖单一写实纵深。一道竖线切过宽大圆形，稳定层叠构图。光线把浅色轮廓从深黑环境中分开，在凸起褶面和细丝上留下柔和的定向亮部。细微颗粒和磨损颜料让最亮区域也保有触感。整体效果神话般庄重，以嵌套的尺度、象征性几何和克制的冷暖对比赋予静止图像叙事广度。
theme_en: An elderly white-bearded traveler with a staff before a glowing orange disc
theme_zh: 一名持杖白须老旅人站在发光的橙色圆盘前
name: The Lord of the Rings
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
